title: 同款药美国贵三倍：美方官员亲口说透，26家药企接受海外价
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: You, of course, will be taking the stage yourself tonight.
segments.zh: 今晚您当然会亲自登台。

segments.en: What is your message to Americans and Republican voters who are concerned about health care affordability?
segments.zh: 对于关心医疗可负担性的美国民众和共和党选民，您想传达什么信息？

segments.en: We're making progress at health care affordability. Evidence by the fact that we have the largest drop in pharmaceutical drug prices for consumers in 63 years.
segments.zh: 我们在医疗可负担性上正取得进展。证据就是，消费者面临的药品价格出现了63年来最大降幅。

segments.en: And the reason for that is not because a lot of things happen outside of Washington, it is because very specifically the President got involved in saying we're not gonna tolerate one in three Americans,
segments.zh: 原因并非华盛顿之外发生了许多事，而是总统明确介入并表示，我们不会容忍三分之一的美国人

segments.en: leaving empty handed from a gross from a drug store when they enter there with a doctor's prescription for medications they need.
segments.zh: 拿着医生处方去药店买所需药物时却空手而归。

segments.en: That's very disenfranchising to the American people.
segments.zh: 这对美国人民来说非常不公平。

segments.en: And so we went out there and learned that about three times more expensive to buy the exact same drugs in America than it is in Europe or Asia.
segments.zh: 于是我们展开调查，发现同样的药物在美国的价格比欧洲或亚洲贵约三倍。

segments.en: Even though it's the same product, being the same factory often here in the US.
segments.zh: 尽管产品相同，往往还产自美国同一家工厂。

segments.en: And so we achieved most favorite nation drug pricing. But as you know, we did not do it through price controls.
segments.zh: 因此我们实现了最惠国药品定价。但如您所知，我们并未通过价格管制来实现。

segments.en: We told all the big pharmaceutical companies, top 26 have all joined in representing 90% of all the drug-sold and drug stores that are branded.
segments.zh: 我们告知所有大型制药公司，前26家已全部加入，它们代表了90%的品牌药品销售和药店。

segments.en: They need the most favorite nation pricing. Whatever it is overseas, same thing here.
segments.zh: 他们需要最惠国定价。海外什么价，这里就什么价。

segments.en: We'll help you get better pricey overseas, but be fair to Americans, no more global freeloading.
segments.zh: 我们会帮你们在海外拿到更好的价格，但要对美国人公平，不能再让全球搭便车。

segments.en: Well, and you were just with the President in the Oval Office last week announcing nine of those new drug pricing deals.
segments.zh: 上周你刚和总统在椭圆形办公室宣布了九项新的药品定价协议。

segments.en: Are there more deals in the works? There are more deals in the works, but we were to cover 90% of all the branded products.
segments.zh: 还有更多协议在推进吗？还有更多在推进，但我们要覆盖90%的品牌产品。

segments.en: So we've gotten most of the work done that we need.
segments.zh: 所以我们需要做的大部分工作已经完成了。
